messages.subject: Project Redwood – completed; SDLT and registration
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel,

Confirming that completion of Kingsgate House took place on 15 May and Thornbury is now the freehold owner. We're attending to post-completion: the SDLT return and payment of £914,500 (due within 14 days), service of notices of assignment on the six tenants, and registration of the transfer at HM Land Registry. We'll send the registered title and a final report once HMLR completes the application.

It's been a pleasure getting this one over the line.

James Osei
Senior Associate
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
